title: Action Songs
text:
We like action songs. An action song has words and actions. When we sing, we move our hands and feet.

The song Head, Shoulders, Knees and Toes is fun. We touch our head, our shoulders, our knees and our toes. Stand up and sing!

questions.text: What do we move when we sing an action song?
What do we touch in the song Head, Shoulders, Knees and Toes?
options: Our head, shoulders, knees and toes

questions.text: Why do children like action songs?
options: They are fun and help them move

questions.text: What does the passage suggest about singing with actions?
options: It helps children learn words by doing them
It makes children tired and sad
It is only for school tests

vocabulary.definition: to make music with your voice
to put your hand on something

paragraph_translations: Lubimy piosenki z ruchem. Piosenka z ruchem ma słowa i ruchy. Kiedy śpiewamy, poruszamy rękami i nogami.
Piosenka Head, Shoulders, Knees and Toes jest zabawna. Dotykamy głowy, ramion, kolan i palców u stóp. Wstańcie i śpiewajcie!
